It tastes good.
Oct 2025 • Couples
The last day of the trip was still served with local food ~

Fried ravioli feels like fried ravioli skin, topped with a pork filling mixed with various spices and red oil, and this can be ordered, slightly spicy and not salty.
Vietnamese pancakes are the signature must-have, and they've given me a taste of my own hand roll. ✌️ Egg cakes are crisp and thin on the side, and they're breaded with fructus shrimp and bean sprouts and other ingredients. Make sure you try them with purée mint. And green mangoes to eat, dipped in fish sauce or peanut butter. 👍

Also ordered a cold dry rice flour, tastes a little rice crusty, except the side dish is a little uncomfortable, should be local wild vegetables, seasoning are good to try. After all, Vietnamese soup river flour is available in many shops, and it's worth a try when you meet someone who hasn't eaten it.
